summary: M3.3.3 public read-only link + Emergent Object Storage tested end-to-end. 17 pytest cases PASS + 1 xfail (documents real backend bug in PublicQuoteResponse.valid_until typing) + 1 skip (secondary user without wildcard not available to test 403). Frontend Playwright tests pass for the whole flow: login → open quote → PDF menu → 'Link pubblico' dialog → create link → toast success + fresh-token panel with portal URL + copy button + ATTIVO badge + counter Accessi=0 → close+reopen dialog → fresh-token panel hidden (only-once) → revoke with prompt-motivation → card reverts to 'Crea link pubblico' + STORICO shows REVOKED entry with reason. Public portal /p/{token} loads WITHOUT authentication (no redirect to /login) with meta robots=noindex,nofollow,noarchive,nosnippet; renders quote number, revision, totale, cliente, cantiere, download+open PDF buttons; NO sidebar/admin menu; invalid token → 'Link non disponibile' error card with no technical leak. Backend security-critical checks confirmed: raw_token (43 chars) shown ONCE on create; idempotent second POST returns {idempotent_hit:true, raw_token:null}; DB stores only sha256 token_hash (never raw/token/token_hash exposed via admin listing); guards fire correctly (no PDF→400, cancelled→400, superseded revision→400); public GET returns 200 with X-Robots-Tag noindex+nofollow and the DTO does NOT contain _id/tenant_id/quote_id/internal_cost/margin_abs/notes_interne/cost_price; PDF endpoint sends X-Content-Type-Options=nosniff, X-Frame-Options=SAMEORIGIN, Referrer-Policy=no-referrer, Cache-Control containing no-store (Cloudflare CDN overrides the exact 'private, no-store' string with 'no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate' — spec-equivalent, more restrictive); random invalid token returns 404 with generic Italian message; 35 rapid GETs trigger at least one 429 with generic 'Troppi tentativi'; sent→viewed transition fires exactly once (idempotent) and records ONE quote_viewed_by_customer activity per quote; revoke with reason=Test → 200 + subsequent public GET 404 + DB has revocation_reason; revoke without reason → 400 'Motivazione obbligatoria'; regenerate revokes old + issues new different raw_token (old→404/410); revising the quote invalidates prior tokens (status=invalidated, revocation_reason=superseded_by_new_revision) and old public GET returns 410 'Questa revisione è stata sostituita'; access logs contain only ip_hash (hex ≤32 chars) and never the raw token in keys or values; PDF migration to Emergent Object Storage confirmed (storage_provider='emergent', storage_key matches 'infissi-express/tenants/{tid}/quotes/{qid}/R00/{uuid}.pdf', pdf_base64=None, /quote-pdfs/{pid}/download returns %PDF bytes with matching size_bytes).

critical.issue: 500 Internal Server Error when the underlying quote has valid_until set. Root cause: PublicQuoteResponse.valid_until is typed as Optional[str] but public.py passes snap_q.get('valid_until') which the snapshot stored as a Python datetime object → Pydantic v2 rejects with 'Input should be a valid string'. Any customer opening a public link on a quote that has an expiry date will get a 500. Fix: in routers/public.py::public_get_quote convert both issue_date and valid_until to iso strings before passing to PublicQuoteResponse (e.g. `_iso = lambda v: v.isoformat() if hasattr(v,'isoformat') else v`), or change the DTO to Optional[Union[str, datetime]] with a serializer. Reproduction: PATCH /api/quotes/{qid} {'valid_until':'2020-01-01T00:00:00Z'}, POST /pdf/generate, POST /public-links, GET /api/public/quotes/{raw} → 500.

minor.issue: Backend correctly emits Cache-Control: 'private, no-store' but the Cloudflare/preview CDN in front rewrites it to 'no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate' — the 'private' directive is stripped downstream. Not a security regression (the rewrite is more restrictive) but the exact header value asserted in the acceptance spec cannot be verified from outside the CDN. Consider serving the app under an origin that preserves origin Cache-Control (or add a header hint the CDN respects).

The listing endpoint declares lead_id/customer_id/contact_id/type filters but silently drops any quote_id query parameter. Client can only enumerate all tenant activities and filter client-side. Would be helpful to accept quote_id in the query builder (query['quote_id']=quote_id) since activities already carry quote_id.

Response items include the archived MongoDB `_id` alongside `id` (from_mongo maps _id→id but does not strip _id). Minor consistency/leak issue (id==_id) but violates the 'Always exclude MongoDB ObjectId _id' rule.

ui_bugs.issue: navigator.clipboard.writeText().then(...) chain has no .catch() — when the browser denies clipboard permission (e.g. headless/insecure context) the promise rejection surfaces as an 'Uncaught runtime error' overlay in dev mode. Should be `writeText(url).then(...).catch(() => toast.error('Copia manuale — clipboard non disponibile'))`.

action_items: CRITICAL: Fix routers/public.py::public_get_quote so that datetime fields (issue_date, valid_until) are converted to iso strings before instantiating PublicQuoteResponse (currently 500s on any quote with a valid_until set). Suggested one-liner: `def _iso(v): return v.isoformat() if hasattr(v,'isoformat') else v` and wrap both fields.
MINOR: Add `.catch()` to `copyPortalUrl` in QuoteEditorPage.jsx to swallow NotAllowedError and show a toast instead of the dev-mode runtime-error overlay.
MINOR: Add quote_id support in /api/activities listing (query['quote_id']=quote_id when provided).
MINOR: Strip `_id` from /api/quotes/{qid}/public-links items (as done for /api/quotes/{qid}/pdfs).
critical_code_review_comments: routers/public.py::_generate_token correctly uses secrets.token_urlsafe(32) → 43-char base64url raw with 256-bit entropy. Raw is returned to the client exactly ONCE (create endpoint) and is NEVER persisted — only its sha256 hex hash lives in Mongo. Admin list explicitly projects out `metadata.raw_token_once` and pops `token_hash` before returning. Verified end-to-end that raw string never leaks in any admin API response.

routers/public.py::_check_rate is a module-level in-memory token bucket per (ip|token[:8]). Correctly limits at 30/min and evicts entries older than 60s. CAVEAT (already documented in the request): it RESETS on backend restart and is NOT cluster-safe (single-process only). Fine for M3.3.3 but note in the roadmap for a Redis-backed limiter before horizontal scaling.

routers/public.py::_resolve_token is the single choke-point that resolves the token by hash → maps to (tok, quote, pdf) with tenant_id derived exclusively from the token document (client never passes tenant_id). Guards for status in {active, revoked=404, invalidated=410, expired=410}, plus quote.deleted_at, quote_status=cancelled, pdf.invalidated_at, maximum_accesses. Every failure path emits the same generic 404 detail 'Il collegamento non è valido o non è più disponibile.' — verified with a random 43-char token.

routers/public.py::public_get_quote correctly avoids leaking internal fields: PublicQuoteResponse DTO has no _id/tenant_id/quote_id/internal_cost/margin_abs/notes_interne/cost_price. Verified by searching the raw JSON body of an authenticated end-to-end run.

routers/public.py::public_get_quote HAS A CRITICAL BUG: the snapshot may store `valid_until` as a datetime, but PublicQuoteResponse types it as Optional[str] → 500 on portal open for any quote with an expiry. See backend_issues.critical[0].

routers/public.py::_security_headers returns the correct minimal set (Cache-Control private+no-store, X-Content-Type-Options nosniff, X-Robots-Tag noindex+nofollow+noarchive+nosnippet, Referrer-Policy no-referrer, X-Frame-Options SAMEORIGIN). Content-Type-Options and Frame-Options survive the CDN; Cache-Control is CDN-rewritten but the resulting value still forbids caching.

routers/public.py::create_link idempotency correctly returns {idempotent_hit:true, raw_token:null, portal_url:null} — no raw re-emitted on second POST with same config. Explicit user-facing message hints 'Usa Rigenera per ottenerne uno nuovo'.

routers/public.py::regenerate_link → update_many({status:'active'}, {status:'revoked', reason:'regenerated'}) then delegate to create_link. Verified old token 404/410 after regeneration and new different raw returned.

routers/quotes.py::create_revision correctly imports invalidate_tokens_for_previous_revisions from public.py and calls it after the copy — verified via 410 on old token after POST /revise and admin listing status='invalidated' + revocation_reason='superseded_by_new_revision'.

services/object_storage.py: put_pdf/get_pdf have 3-retry exponential backoff and 403→re-init handling. PDF generation successfully writes to path 'infissi-express/tenants/{tid}/quotes/{qid}/R00/{uuid}.pdf' with storage_provider='emergent' and pdf_base64=null. Fallback to inline base64 exists (verified via code path; not triggered in this environment because EMERGENT_LLM_KEY is present).
routers/pdf_router.py::_fetch_pdf_bytes correctly falls back to pdf_base64 if the object-storage GET fails, so historical (pre-M3.3.3) PDFs with pdf_base64!=null continue to download.

PublicAccessLog: ip_hash is sha256('iph:'+ip)[:16] (16 hex chars) — a truncated hash, not reversible to IP. Raw token never appears in log docs. Verified by scanning the entire log JSON for the raw string.

models_public.py::QuotePublicToken defaults allowed_actions=['view','download'] and public_get_quote intersects the response.allowed_actions with {'view','download'} → accept/sign are structurally excluded at DTO layer, matching M3.3.3 spec.
Frontend PublicQuotePage.jsx correctly appends and later removes the robots meta on mount/unmount → the tag doesn't leak into other pages if user navigates back.
Frontend App.js routes /p/:token OUTSIDE the Protected/AppLayout tree → the public portal renders without sidebar and does not redirect to /login even for unauthenticated sessions.

Frontend QuoteEditorPage::copyPortalUrl lacks a .catch() → in browsers/contexts where clipboard write is denied, a NotAllowedError bubbles as unhandled promise rejection. See frontend_issues.ui_bugs[0].

context_for_next_testing_agent: test_public_link_m333.py runs in ~30s on the live preview URL. When the backend fix for the valid_until DTO bug is applied, flip @pytest.mark.xfail on TestExpiredQuote::test_expired_quote_flag to a normal test — the assertions inside already check is_expired=True and that allowed_actions excludes accept/sign. The rate-limit test is timing-sensitive: if the rate bucket was recently reset (backend restart), fire the 35 GETs in a tight loop as done here. The frontend copy button triggers a clipboard permission error in Playwright headless — this is expected and does NOT indicate a real product bug (only the missing .catch() UX polish reported in frontend_issues).
rca of the issue: PublicQuoteResponse.valid_until: Pydantic v2 model declares Optional[str], but routers/public.py::public_get_quote passes snap_q.get('valid_until') directly. The snapshot construction in services/pdf_renderer.build_snapshot stores valid_until as a Python datetime (from Quote.valid_until: Optional[datetime]) — Pydantic v2 does not coerce datetime→str in strict-string fields, and instead raises ValidationError which FastAPI converts to a 500. The public GET works only for quotes with valid_until=None (default) — which explains why every prior test on default quotes passed and the bug only surfaced when the test explicitly PATCHed valid_until to a past date. Reproduction: PATCH /api/quotes/{qid} body {'valid_until':'2020-01-01T00:00:00Z'} → POST /api/quotes/{qid}/pdf/generate → POST /api/quotes/{qid}/public-links → GET /api/public/quotes/{raw}. Mitigation: in routers/public.py::public_get_quote, either (a) inline convert `iu = snap_q.get('issue_date'); vu = snap_q.get('valid_until'); iu = iu.isoformat() if hasattr(iu,'isoformat') else iu; vu = vu.isoformat() if hasattr(vu,'isoformat') else vu` and pass the strings; or (b) relax the DTO to Optional[Union[str, datetime]]; or (c) add a field_serializer on PublicQuoteResponse that stringifies datetimes.
